projects.name: AssetCare
projects.summary: A production-deployed Java 25, Spring Boot, Angular and Kubernetes application demonstrating modern full-stack, cloud-native and AI-assisted software engineering.
projects.availability: Reference application, not for sale. Public showcase and live demo; full source available on request.
notes: Runs on one Hetzner CX33 created by Terraform; CI, security and release pipelines on GitHub Actions with signed multi-arch images.
The observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, OpenTelemetry) is an optional profile and is not running in production.

projects.name: BlitzMath
projects.summary: Live maths battles for classrooms and families: a teacher or parent hosts, children join with a six-digit code on their own device, and everyone answers the same questions at the same time. No accounts, no ads, no chat.
projects.availability: Free to play. Not part of the for-sale catalogue.
projects.privacy: No accounts and no id for a device or a person. A child's progress stays on the child's device; a room and its nicknames are deleted when the game is over.
notes: One Durable Object per game room holds the questions, the clock and the scores, so the server is the referee and nothing can be faked from a child's device.
English, German, French and Italian. Practice for the Swiss Gymnasium entrance exams: 17 skills after 6th class and 18 skills after Sek.
Parents' packs with Stripe checkout and licence codes are built and not yet on sale.

projects.name: nüchtern

projects.privacy: Records stay on the user's device.

projects.name: Daily Momentum
projects.summary: A quiet record of where the day went: one tap says what you are doing, everything else is derived. On-device only.
projects.privacy: Records stay on the user's device.

projects.name: Loop
projects.summary: Remembers what repeats and learns the rhythm from your own history, on your device or your own Drive.
projects.privacy: Records stay on the user's device or in storage the user owns.

projects.name: BabyLoop

projects.name: LeftHere
projects.summary: Take a photo and it remembers where you left the car, keys, bag or a favourite place; the map walks you back. On your device or your own Drive.
projects.privacy: Records stay on the user's device or in storage the user owns.

projects.name: MP3 Alarm Clock
projects.summary: A desktop alarm clock that plays an MP3 or your own recorded voice at a scheduled time, keeps the computer awake and wakes it from sleep, with family schedules and a phone remote. One Python file, macOS, Windows and Linux.
projects.availability: Free and open source under the MIT licence.
projects.privacy: Alarms, recordings and logs live in the folder next to the app. The phone remote works on the home Wi-Fi only.
